sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: FSSAI Registration is required for any food business in India that produces, stores, transports, or distributes food. You may require this registration or license depending on the size and nature of your business. In this Registration, the FBO (Food Business Operator) gets a 14 digit number. After getting a FSSAI certificate in India, one can get many benefits, like building a goodwill of the business, ensure food safety, business expansion, and investments.

Every person dealing with the food business, like manufacturing, processing, storage, or any other things related to food products need to obtain this Registration or License. It is a 14-digit registration or a license number that must be printed on all the packets of food products. The 14-digit FSSAI registration number provides all the essential details about the producer of food products. The objective of this registration is to ensure the highest quality of the food products. The licensing and registration procedure in India is regulated by Food Safety & Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Business) Regulations, 2011.
Legal Compliance: It supports to abide by the mandatory rules and regulations, thus preventing legal procedures and punitive actions against the concerned firm.
Consumer trust: Assurance of food safety shows trustworthiness to consumers and increase customers.
Expansion opportunities: FSSAI certificate in India provides you with the opportunities to provide services in government institutions, schools, and hospitals.
Information access: It gives all the information and updates on food safety and quality.
Brand reputation: It can help in brand building since the customer becomes loyal and results in high sales.
Risk Reduction: The risk of foodborne illness can be reduced as FSSAI registration maintains stringent food safety standards and inspection.
This registration is based on the type of the business, turnover and quantity of production. Mainly there are three types of food registration in India.
FSSAI Basic Registration- It is mandatory for the food businesses that have an annual turnover of less than Rs.12 lakh. To get this registration, you need to fill a Form A.

FSSAI State License - Food businesses that have an annual turnover of more than Rs.12 lakh but less than Rs.20 crore need to obtain the FSSAI registration. In order to get a FSSAI state license, one has to fill Form B.
FSSAI Central License- It is obligatory for the FBOs having an annual turnover of more than Rs.20 crore to obtain this license. You can obtain it by filling the Form B.
We are giving a list of essential documents for this registration
List of Directors/Partners/Proprietor/Member of Society/Trust with full addresses, contact details, and nomination of an authorized signatory.
Government-issued Photo ID and address proof of the FPOs.

How long is FSSAI registration valid?
FSSAI registration or license can be valid for one year or five years based on the Government fee paid.
Do I need FSSAI registration if I am operating a home kitchen?
Yes, FSSAI registration is mandatory for all those operating a home kitchen or bakery in India.
Can FSSAI registration or License be obtained online?
Yes, the entire process for obtaining FSSAI registration or license is conducted online, and there's no need for applicants to visit any physical office.
Can FSSAI registration or License be done online?
Yes, the entire process for taking FSSAI registration or license can be done online, and no applicants are required to go to any office.
Should I put the FSSAI number on the invoice?
Yes, from October 1, 2021, all food businesses are required to place their FSSAI registration or license number on bills and invoices
Do I need to pay GST on FSSAI?

Yes, from July 27, 2022, GST is levied on various services availed from FSSAI, such as issuance of a Central license, Food Safety Mitra scheme fees, Product Approval Fees, Import Clearance Fees, etc., at an 18% service tax rate.
